count_pairs_sum_x: count pairs from two sorted arrays whose sum equals a given value x

test_f_filled_vs_f_gold: test the f_filled implementation against the f_gold reference solution using parameter sets

summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that counts pairs across two arrays summing to a target value
